why: The corpora are rebuilt from Project Gutenberg files that gutenberg.org can, and does, re-edit in place. artifacts/pivot/corpus_manifest.json banks the sha256 of the exact source bytes the corpora were built from; this file records how to get back to those bytes from an upstream edition that has since changed, so a cold clone still rebuilds byte-identically. Every edit here is a transcription-level difference in a public-domain text, recorded verbatim in both directions. An upstream edition NOT listed here is a hard failure of tools/pivot/pin_sources.py, never a silent substitution - the measurements stand as banked, but the rebuild-is-identical claim would then be false for that file and must be said so.
